introduction: Trace the glacier lich's three distinct shards and independent swamp trophies, then prepare Leppts' armor commission. Active, ready accounting is required. Current material and accepted deliveries remain separate from personal kills, first recovery, learned words, access and actual transformations. Missing stalk supply, scarce hides and guarded mixed payment remain open.
orientation: Enter the valley from the surface, descend into the swamp and follow the lake's upward stair to the tower. Its lich accepts seven independent exact-item outcomes and stays after delivery. Asking his native words reveals lore rather than awarding a learned-keyword milestone.

The tribal chieftain's reverse-running hourglass gives the green shard; the astereater's bleeding eye gives yellow; the enslaver's writhing tentacle gives blue. Their three distinct shards give a prismatic pyramid. Personal producer histories are optional, so supplied matching shards fit. Three copies of one color do not fit.

The lich also accepts the ice hydra's severed head, a mutated sundew stalk and a swamp-dragon scale through separate rewards. Their success text mentions kills, reagents and transformation, but only exact delivery is recorded. The stalk has no reviewed active producer; its source repair remains pending.

The astereater, illithid, hydra and swamp dragon have thirty-five, twenty, fifteen and five percent reset declarations respectively. The giant sundew has fifteen percent, without a declared stalk. These probabilities explain rare sources without guaranteeing stock or inventing personal kills.

At the bloody grotto, push rock to clear the west exit's blocked state. The exit remains secret and closed: search for the passage and open it. A separately rare pit fiend blocks ordinary westward movement while present. No key is required. Actual control, passage and safe return need their own evidence.

The grotto tube leads west to a shaft with two one-hundred-percent falling rooms above the tribe. The preceding slope's twenty-percent declaration lacks a down exit and is cleared by the loader. The lake also has a downward route to the lava tubes; it avoids that shaft, while tribal guards still affect travel.

The underground death knight blocks ordinary northward passage and supplies two distinct cold-iron weapons. The tribal chieftain carries the hourglass. The astereater's moor passage is secret and closed but unlocked; reveal and open it rather than searching for an invented key.

The lich refuses one remorhaz hide and refers you to Leppts. Native settlement consumes the offered hide and issues another of the same kind; this is not an unchanged item identity, new supply, producer milestone or achievement. The referral is optional for the commission.

Leppts is supplied from a surface dispersal room and wanders. His commission belongs to the Snow Ogres journal even when met on the surface; physical area discovery and journal ownership are separate. After discovering the valley, open its journal explicitly for this service.

Bring six exact remorhaz hides, one cold-iron claymore and one cold-iron greatsword, plus 2,500 platinum. Four remorhaz declarations provide only three hides with cap three. Sufficient accepted supply and renewal are pending, and the item-and-coin exchange remains guarded. Material checks cannot prove payment or availability. The vambrace commission gives no achievement or daily credit.

The tower's flesh golems, magical weapons and skull-knee leggings have effects beyond item delivery. Those effects do not award an additional journal milestone. Material checks explain what you carry; they cannot certify a safe fight, successful equipment change or use of a reward.

The war chief's crude note, searching party, lich phylactery and narrated transformation provide lore without an additional quest finale. Asking questions and exploring these clues does not complete another delivery or record a personal reunion, teaching lesson or transformation.

contacts.description: Rare moor astereater behind a secret, closed, unlocked door. Carries the bleeding eye for the lich's yellow shard; source probability does not guarantee current availability.

contacts.name: a snow ogre war chief
contacts.description: War chief in the chieftain's entourage. Carries a crude note; its search-party lore has no reviewed native delivery consumer or rescue/reunion terminal.

contacts.name: a snow ogre tribal chieftain
contacts.description: Tribal hall chieftain. Carries the lich's reverse-running hourglass. The guarded grotto route and alternate lake descent explain access without granting a personal recovery milestone.

contacts.name: Lrethlamn Soel, the glacier lich
contacts.description: Tower lich. Ask hi, hello, time, negative or hourglass. Accepts seven independent trophy/shard outcomes. One hide only elicits a referral to Leppts, with no achievement. No additional teaching milestone is defined.

contacts.name: a four-armed decaying flesh golem
contacts.description: Large lich companion and cadaver-pit golem. Fighting it, summoned companions or its regeneration does not complete an additional journal objective.

contacts.name: a gigantic mutated sundew plant
contacts.description: Gigantic mutated sundew with a rare swamp declaration. No carried stalk is declared here either; intended reagent production requires a separate builder-selected repair.

contacts.name: a skulking illithid enslaver
contacts.description: Rare enslaver in the dense swamp. Carries the writhing illithid tentacle for the blue shard. Its worn roper-tentacle whip has a combat effect and is different proof.

contacts.name: an ice hydra
contacts.description: Rare swamp ice hydra. Carries the severed hydra head. The head-on-chain reward is another item kind; native delivery does not require your personal killing blow.

contacts.name: a nefarious pit fiend from Avernus
contacts.description: Rare pit fiend at the bloody grotto blocks ordinary westward movement when present. Push the rock to clear the separate blocked-wall state, then reveal/open the secret door; neither action is an achievement.

contacts.name: Leppts, the tinker
contacts.description: Tinker supplied from a surface dispersal source rather than a local valley reset; he can wander. Ask hi, hello, lrethlamn, soel, lich, yes, sent, find, remorhaz, ice or worm. Open the discovered Snow Ogres journal for his six-hide/two-weapon/2,500-platinum commission; physical surface discovery is separate.

contacts.name: a four-armed decaying flesh golem
contacts.description: Smaller flesh golem shares the large golem's short name but is a different creature. Its presence does not establish a completed guardian or summoning objective.
